mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and compressing corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%, or the tightening is not sustained (FEDFUNDS reverts below 4.5% within 30 days).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and employment (PAYEMS) rises simultaneously, it signals a robust labor market and strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both conditions are met, or the effect diminishes in non-expansionary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below the previous quarter's level signals policy accommodation, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when FEDFUNDS is declining in a tightening cycle, or the decline is not sustained (FEDFUNDS rebounds within 30 days).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above the prior quarter's level reflects robust supply-side activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when INDPRO is rising over 5 days, or the increase is not sustained (INDPRO reverts below trend within 10 days).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 10,000 billion chained 2017 dollars signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive despite GDPC1 crossing above 10,000, or the spike is temporary (GDPC1 reverts below within 30 days).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% and housing starts (HOUST) increase simultaneously, it indicates improving labor market conditions and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both conditions are met, or the effect is isolated to non-recessionary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal sustained demand for housing, boosting sector performance and contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when HOUST is rising in a late-cycle expansion, or the rise is not sustained (HOUST declines within 30 days).
